title: Production Architecture, Global Authentication, Neural Feed Upgrades & VISAR Uplink
label: Internal Alpha
summary: This monumental update transforms VISAR Edge into a highly secure, scalable, and production-ready platform. Enjoy a smoother interface that never freezes, secure Google logins, blazing-fast AI memory, and real-time chat directly with the creator.

sections.title: Added & New Features
items: Introduced a seamless setup experience allowing you to log in securely using your Email or a Google Account.
Added a quick-login window to easily resume expired sessions and a new central Profile Manager to view your account details.
Launched VISAR Uplink: a highly secure, real-time chat feature that lets you communicate directly with the creator right from the app.
Built a beautiful, easy-to-use Wallpaper Manager. Browse thumbnails and apply new backgrounds instantly without needing to restart VISAR.
Upgraded the chat box to automatically expand as you type, and added a smart action button that instantly transforms into a highly visible red 'STOP' button to halt the AI in emergencies.
Released a massive update to the Windows Deep Cleaner (v4.0) featuring a fresh new look and deeper system cleaning capabilities.

sections.title: Improvements & System Redux
items: Completely separated the visual interface from the AI 'Brain.' VISAR will now remain incredibly fast, responsive, and crash-resistant even when the AI is processing heavy tasks in the background.
Reorganized how VISAR stores your personal settings, securing them in protected Windows folders to meet enterprise privacy standards.
Upgraded VISAR's internal memory engine, allowing the AI to search through its knowledge base and recall information at blazing-fast speeds.
Optimized background processing so that when certain features are turned off, VISAR consumes exactly 0% of your computer's CPU, saving battery and system resources.
Enhanced the Status Bar to show a much more accurate reflection of your computer's actual processing power and multi-core usage.

sections.title: Fixes & Security
items: Strengthened global security by completely hiding sensitive server configurations and enforcing strict backend identity verifications.
Fixed an annoying visual bug where loading spinners would get stuck on the screen forever.
Corrected various visual glitches across the News and Social tabs, fixed sidebar buttons, and resolved issues where background colors wouldn't load properly.
Fixed a bug that occasionally prevented the login screen from appearing when switching accounts.

sections.title: Removed & Deprecated
items: Removed older, slower memory databases to make room for the new high-speed AI recall system.
Removed outdated background logic that was previously causing the app interface to slow down.

notes: Version 1.6.0.0 elevates VISAR Edge to a professional standard. By decoupling the interface from the heavy AI processing and adding secure global authentication, the app is now incredibly fast, stable, and ready for everyday use.
